directory_entries.measure: Each immediate filesystem directory-entry occurrence in the synthetic fixture directory.
directory_entries.checkpoint: Before source selection, attribute reads, or file opens.

relevant_records.measure: Each selected canonical player record after primary/old physical-source selection.
relevant_records.checkpoint: Immediately after source selection and before compressed ingress.

compressed_bytes_per_file.measure: Selected file bytes from the first gzip header byte through physical EOF.
compressed_bytes_per_file.checkpoint: Bounded channel ingress before gzip classification.

decompressed_bytes_per_file.measure: Unnamed Compound type byte, zero-length UTF root name, complete Compound payload, EndTag, and exact decompressed EOF.
decompressed_bytes_per_file.checkpoint: Bounded decompressed stream before bytes are returned to the NBT scanner.

container_depth_per_file.measure: Container nesting with the unnamed root Compound at depth 1.
container_depth_per_file.checkpoint: Before entering each CompoundTag or ListTag payload.

compound_containers_per_file.measure: Every CompoundTag instance, including the unnamed root Compound.

compound_field_entries_per_file.measure: Every Compound child entry; EndTag is excluded.
compound_field_entries_per_file.checkpoint: Immediately after the child type byte and before reading the UTF length prefix or materializing the field name.

list_elements_per_file.measure: Every ListTag payload element; the list header is excluded.
list_elements_per_file.checkpoint: At the non-negative list-length prefix before element materialization.

byte_array_elements_per_file.measure: Every byte-array payload element; the length field is excluded.
byte_array_elements_per_file.checkpoint: At the non-negative array-length prefix before payload allocation.

int_array_elements_per_file.measure: Every int-array payload element; the length field is excluded.
int_array_elements_per_file.checkpoint: At the non-negative array-length prefix before payload allocation.

long_array_elements_per_file.measure: Every long-array payload element; the length field is excluded.
long_array_elements_per_file.checkpoint: At the non-negative array-length prefix before payload allocation.

modified_utf8_bytes_per_file.measure: Java modified-UTF encoded bytes in Compound field names and StringTag payloads; each two-byte length prefix is excluded.
modified_utf8_bytes_per_file.checkpoint: At each unsigned UTF byte-length prefix before byte/character allocation or String construction.

scalar_tags_per_file.measure: Byte, Short, Int, Long, Float, Double, and String tags; End, Compound, List, ByteArray, IntArray, and LongArray are excluded.
scalar_tags_per_file.checkpoint: At scalar tag-kind dispatch before payload materialization.

compressed_bytes_total.measure: Checked sum of selected-file compressed coordinates.
compressed_bytes_total.checkpoint: Before adding each selected file to the aggregate.

decompressed_bytes_total.measure: Checked sum of complete unnamed-Compound decompressed coordinates.
decompressed_bytes_total.checkpoint: For each returned decompressed chunk after the per-file check and before NBT consumes the bytes.

compound_containers_total.measure: Checked sum of per-file CompoundTag instance counts.
compound_containers_total.checkpoint: Before accepting each next Compound container event.

compound_field_entries_total.measure: Checked sum of per-file Compound child-entry counts.
compound_field_entries_total.checkpoint: At each field event before field-name materialization.

list_elements_total.measure: Checked sum of all ListTag payload elements.
list_elements_total.checkpoint: At each list-length prefix before element materialization.

byte_array_elements_total.measure: Checked sum of all byte-array payload elements.
byte_array_elements_total.checkpoint: At each array-length prefix before payload allocation.

int_array_elements_total.measure: Checked sum of all int-array payload elements.
int_array_elements_total.checkpoint: At each array-length prefix before payload allocation.

long_array_elements_total.measure: Checked sum of all long-array payload elements.
long_array_elements_total.checkpoint: At each array-length prefix before payload allocation.

modified_utf8_bytes_total.measure: Checked sum of modified-UTF bytes in field names and StringTag payloads.
modified_utf8_bytes_total.checkpoint: At each unsigned UTF byte-length prefix before per-file/aggregate state publication.

scalar_tags_total.measure: Checked sum of included scalar tag-kind events.
scalar_tags_total.checkpoint: At each scalar tag-kind dispatch before payload materialization.

attachment_admissions.measure: Each non-null gramarye:player_skills Tag delivered once to the shared P4-C admission core; Ready, PreservedRaw, and OversizeMarker are attempts.
attachment_admissions.checkpoint: After P4-C admission completes and before accepting the next selected record.

raw_root_claims.measure: Online/offline latest and equipped references plus journal targets before any deduplication.
raw_root_claims.checkpoint: At raw claim capture before SkillRetentionRootSnapshot construction.
